dct_description_sm: The data was collected as part of PhD research work and as data for the Polar Data Catalogue; to understand the passive microwave (PMW) emissions of the ocean surface roughness of the open ocean/marginal ice zone around the study site before and after storm occurances; and, to obtain PMW signatures of a variety of sea ice targets, along with coincident in situ geophysical data, for the purpose of describing the various sea ice types. An inter-comparison with satellite PMW emission data is also sought for.
dct_title_s: Passive Microwave radiometer (19, 37, 89 GHz) data in Baffin Bay
